Education

Maybank Group Scholarship Programme


About this programme

Granting of scholarships to deserving Malaysian students to pursue their tertiary education has been a key feature of Maybank’s CSR efforts since 1972.

Education pillar objective

It is a major component of the ‘Education’ theme from the three (3) Corporate Responsibility pillars adopted by Maybank Foundation, with the main objective of:

Provide financial assistance to deserving students with high potential.

Create a strong Entry Level Pipeline comprising fresh graduates from top-tier universities.

Strengthen Maybank’s reputation as the top employer of talents, particularly amongst fresh graduates.

Since 1972, we have empowered more than 2,000 scholars by granting them access to quality undergraduate education in various disciplines related to banking and future-ready fields at leading universities, both locally and abroad. Beginning in 2019, the Maybank Group Scholarship Programme expanded to countries where Maybank has a significant local presence and offers full banking services-namely Cambodia, Indonesia, and the Philippines.

Full scholarships are awarded to selected students with high potential in their academic and extra-curricular activities as well as outstanding leadership qualities, who are sponsored to study at top-tier universities in Malaysia and the United Kingdom (UK).

Such scholarships will cover the full cost of tuition and enrolment fees, and related expenses including books, accommodation, and living allowances.

Requirements

To be eligible for the Maybank Group Scholarship Programme, applicants must meet all the below requirements:

  • Total gross household income of not more than RM120,000 per annum
  • Not more than 22 years of age
  • Currently enrolled in 1st year undergraduate studies at any of the following public local universities:
    – Universiti Malaya (UM)
    – Universiti Putra Malaysia (UPM)
    – Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia (UKM)
    – Universiti Teknologi Mara (UiTM)
    – International Islamic University Malaysia (IIUM)
    – Universiti Sains Malaysia (USM)
    – Universiti Teknologi Malaysia (UTM)
    – Universiti Utara Malaysia (UUM)
    – Universiti Malaysia Terengganu (UMT)
    – Universiti Malaysia Pahang Al-Sultan Abdullah (UMPSA)
    – Universiti Malaysia Sarawak (UNIMAS)
    – Universiti Malaysia Sabah (UMS)
  • Total gross household income of not more than RM180,000 per annum
  • Not more than 22 years of age
  • Have been accepted to pursue a full-time degree in selected top-tier universities in the UK (obtained admission letter or condition letter offer)
  • Successfully completed any equivalent pre-university programme such as STPM, Foundation, Matriculation, Diploma, etc.

Discipline of Study

  • Art and Design

  • Business and Management

  • Computer Science and Information
    Technology

  • Education

  • Engineering and Technology

  • Environmental Science /
    Studies

  • Humanities and Social Work

  • Mathematics / Actuarial Science

  • Social Sciences

  • Future Ready Related Courses*

  • *e.g. Computer Programming, Web Development, Software Development, Mobile Application Development, UI/UX Design, Data Science, etc.

What does the Maybank Group Scholarship Programme offer?

Funding

  • Enrolment and full tuition fees
  • Laptop
  • Books Allowance
  • Monthly allowances for living and accommodation

Development programmes

  • Maybank Student Ambassador Programme (#Mbassador)
  • Boot Camps & Team-Building
  • Community-based Learning
  • Certification for Future Ready courses

Internship & placement

  • To give exposure on work-life experience within the Maybank Group
  • Offers employment opportunities right after graduation

Frequently asked questions

/What is the Maybank Group Scholarship?

Full scholarships are awarded to selected students with high potential in their academic and extra-curricular activities as well as outstanding leadership qualities, who are sponsored to study at top-tier universities in Malaysia and the United Kingdom.

/I am a Maybank staff. Am I eligible for the Maybank Scholarship?

Maybank Group Staff is not eligible to apply for the Maybank Scholarship. However, confirmed staff whose children and relatives who meet the qualifying criteria may apply for the scholarship.

/What are the qualifying criteria for the Maybank Scholarship?

FOR LOCAL STUDIES IN MALAYSIA

  • Total gross household income of not more than RM120,000 per annum
  • Not more than 22 years of age
  • Currently enrolled in 1st year undergraduate studies at any of the following local public universities:
    • – Universiti Malaya (UM)
    • – Universiti Putra Malaysia (UPM)
    • – Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia (UKM)
    • – Universiti Teknologi Mara (UiTM)
    • – International Islamic University Malaysia (IIUM)
    • – Universiti Sains Malaysia (USM)
    • – Universiti Teknologi Malaysia (UTM)
    • – Universiti Utara Malaysia (UUM)
    • – Universiti Malaysia Perlis (UniMAP)
    • – Universiti Malaysia Pahang (UMP)
    • – Universiti Malaysia Sabah (UMS)
    • – Universiti Malaysia Sarawak (UNIMAS)

FOR OVERSEAS STUDIES

  • Total gross household income of not more than RM180,000 per annum
  • Currently enrolled in a Foundation programme, and have been accepted to pursue a full-time degree in selected top-tier universities in the UK (Admission Letter or Conditional Letter Offer)
  • Not more than 22 years of age
  • Foundation studies in A-levels, International Baccalaureate, Diploma, Matriculation or equivalent
/What are the fields of study accepted to qualify for the Maybank Scholarship?

Candidate’s fields of study must be related to the Bank’s core business and activities:

  • Arts and Design
  • Business and Management
  • Computer Science and Information Technology
  • Education
  • Engineering and Technology
  • Environmental Science / Studies
  • Humanities
  • Mathematics
  • Social Sciences
  • Future Ready-Related Courses (for example: Data Science and Analytics, Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning, Digital Marketing, Environmental Sustainability, etc.)
/What is the scholarship package for Maybank Scholarship?

This full scholarship covers tuition fees, laptop, books allowances, monthly allowances for living and accommodation.

As for overseas scholarships, the full scholarship will also include flight tickets at the beginning and end of the period of study, student visa, insurance coverage, one-time settling-in allowance and one-time clothing allowance.

/What is the selection process?

Maybank conducts a rigorous and robust selection process to select the scholarship recipients.

Shortlisted candidates will then be required to attend several assessments and interviews determined by the selection committee.

/What are the expectations of a Maybank Scholar during the period of scholarship?

You are expected to perform at the highest level throughout the duration of your study. Scholars must satisfy all course works, examinations and/or dissertation requirements, as well as maintain a CGPA of 3.00 every semester.

/Will Maybank provide scholarship to students to pursue pre-university or postgraduate education?

The Bank only provide scholarships to undergraduate studies.

/Upon completion of the study programme would I be contractually bounded to work at the Bank?

All Maybank scholars are bonded and guaranteed of a job placement. The exact time a Maybank Scholar starts serving the scholarship bond will be from the date he/she is employed.

Our scholarship bond are as follows:

Local studies:

Overseas studies:

3-year bond

5-year bond

/Can I apply if I am currently receiving loans/grants/bursaries from other organisation?

Candidates who are currently bonded with other scholarship providers are not eligible to apply.

However, candidates who are currently receiving education loans, study grants, zakat assistance or any form of financial aid from other organisations without an obligation to serve a scholarship bond, are eligible to apply for Maybank Group Scholarship Programme. Nevertheless, candidates must terminate their current financial aid upon accepting a scholarship or bursary from Maybank.

/I just missed the application closing date. Can you accept my application if I submit now?

Applications received after the specified closing date will not be accepted. Should you meet the minimum requirements, you are strongly encouraged to apply the following year.

/I applied last year but was not successful. If I reapply, will my application be considered?

All applications are treated as a fresh application. Thus, your application will be accepted for consideration if it meets the stated requirements.

/How do I apply for Maybank Group Scholarship?

lease visit Maybank Foundation’s website for details of the programme and click on the “Apply Now” link at the bottom of the page to begin your application process.

https://www.maybankfoundation.com/index.php/our-impact/maybank-group-scholarship-programme

/I have a question not listed here, who do I contact?

Please email mf.inquiry@maybank.com or alternatively you may contact us (+603 20708833, extension 36175, 36173, 36177, 36179) for all scholarship-related enquiries.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Have questions about partnering with Maybank Foundation for BSAS 2027? Find out more about the programme, application requirements and selection process below.

A. About BSAS 2027

  1. What is the Balai Seni Art Series (BSAS)?
    The Balai Seni Art Series (BSAS) is a Maybank Foundation initiative that supports the development and appreciation of arts and culture through programmes that nurture artistic talent, preserve cultural heritage and create meaningful opportunities for arts and cultural practitioners and communities.
  1. What programmes are open for applications under BSAS 2027?
    Organisations may apply to partner with Maybank Foundation under any of the following programmes:
        • MyTIGER Values Art Competition (MTVAC)
        • Cultural Art Showcase and Bazaar (CASB)
        • Maybank Foundation Artist Fellowship Programme (MFAFP)
        • New Arts & Culture Programme – an open-concept programme for proposed arts and culture initiatives.
  1. Can an organisation apply for more than one programme?
    Yes. Organisations may apply for one, multiple or all four programmes. A separate proposal, including the proposed approach, implementation plan and budget, must be submitted for each programme applied for.

B. Eligibility and Requirements

  1. Who is eligible to apply?
    Registered organisations with relevant experience and capabilities in arts, culture or creative programme delivery across ASEAN are invited to apply. Applicants should demonstrate their ability to develop, manage and deliver programmes aligned with the objectives of the selected BSAS programme.
  2. Can organisations based outside Malaysia apply?
    Yes. Eligible organisations from ASEAN Member States may apply. Organisations outside Malaysia should submit the equivalent legal registration or establishment documents recognised in their respective countries.
  3. Can an organisation apply if it has not previously partnered with Maybank Foundation?
    Yes. Organisations that have not previously worked with Maybank Foundation may apply, provided they meet the eligibility requirements and can demonstrate relevant experience, capabilities and a suitable approach to delivering the proposed programme.
  1. What should be included in the proposal deck?
    Each proposal deck should be tailored to the selected programme and include the following:
    1. Programme Overview: Proposed concept, objectives and alignment with the selected BSAS programme.
    2. Approach and Value Proposition: Programme design, delivery approach and the needs or opportunities addressed.
    3. Target Beneficiaries and Intended Impact: Target audience, expected reach, key outcomes and measurable impact.
    4. Scope of Work and Deliverables: Key activities, implementation plan, timeline, milestones and expected outputs.
    5. Partnership and Delivery Capability: Proposed team, relevant experience, key partners and resources required.
    6. Budget and Funding Request: Itemised budget, funding requested and any co-funding or other resources, where applicable.
    7. Sustainability and Scalability: Plans to sustain outcomes, extend impact or scale the programme beyond the implementation period.
    8. Monitoring and Evaluation: Proposed indicators and methods to track progress, measure results and report impact.

       

  1. What supporting documents must be submitted?
    Applicants should provide the required organisational information, relevant legal registration or establishment documents, and a proposal deck for each programme selected. Additional information or supporting documents may be requested during the assessment and due diligence processes.

C. How to Apply

  1. How can an organisation submit an application?
    Interested organisations should complete the BSAS 2027 Partner Application Form through the application link provided on Maybank Foundation’s website. Applicants must select their preferred programme(s) and upload the corresponding proposal deck for each programme.
  1. What is the application deadline?
    The application deadline is 8 November 2026, 11:59 PM MYT (UTC+8). Applicants are encouraged to submit their applications and supporting documents before the deadline to allow sufficient time for review.
  1. What happens after an application is submitted?
    Applications will undergo an evaluation process to assess their suitability for the selected programme. Shortlisted organisations may be contacted for further information, clarification or supporting documents and may be required to undergo Maybank Foundation’s due diligence, compliance checks and procurement processes.
  1. What happens if an application is incomplete or additional information is required?
    Maybank Foundation may request clarification, additional information or supporting documents where necessary. Applicants are responsible for ensuring that their submissions are complete and that the information provided is accurate.

D. Evaluation and Selection

  1. How will applications be evaluated?
    Applications will be assessed based on their alignment with the objectives of the selected BSAS programme, the strength and relevance of the proposed concept, expected outcomes and impact, implementation approach, organisational capability, budget and overall feasibility.
  1. Does submitting an application guarantee selection or appointment as a programme partner?
    No. Submission of an application does not guarantee selection or appointment as a BSAS 2027 programme partner. All applications are subject to evaluation and the relevant approval, due diligence and procurement processes.
  1. When will successful applicants be notified?
    Applications will be evaluated from 9 November to 15 December 2026, with the selection outcomes scheduled for consideration by the Maybank Foundation Board. Further information on the announcement of successful applicants will be communicated when available.

E. General Enquiries

  1. Who can I contact if I have further questions?
    For enquiries regarding the BSAS 2027 Partner Application, please contact Maybank Foundation through the general enquiry in the “Who We Are” section provided on the website.
